16-16.main::archive3-gallery-pro-carouse.note: Slot capacity is accepted: the eleven portrait slots can hold the eleven named artists. Current pacing is not accepted. The carousel uses variable motion—fast spins followed by slow sections—so artist names do not have enough stable dwell time to land clearly with their cards. Keep this treatment conditional until an existing supported native or authorized post-production method is verified that synchronizes each name with its card and provides readable dwell time; do not assume a single global speed change solves the variable timing.

16-16.main::archive3-comparison-pack-ae-.note: Not the best choice. Although the two-column text treatment can separate the 2009 and 2010 cohorts, showing only a list of names is visually weaker than showing images of the people mentioned. Prefer an existing image-based treatment that presents the eleven artists and preserves the two cohort distinction.
